summary: Full e2e test of the rebuilt React+FastAPI 'Jarvis Personal OS'. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass against the public URL (/api/, /api/health, /api/chat incl. style presets + validation, /api/email, /api/research with live DuckDuckGo sources, /api/build incl. refine). Frontend: site now loads the Jarvis Command Center (no Emergent placeholder); all 5 tabs work end to end - Chat returned an AI reply, presets toggle active state, Email produced a full draft, Research returned a cited summary + 6 clickable sources, Image rendered a Pollinations image with Open/Download link, App Builder generated a working interactive todo app in the iframe and the Refine box successfully updated it. One real frontend bug found: unhandled clipboard promise rejection from the Copy button.

minor.issue: LLM/search failures are swallowed and returned as HTTP 200 with a '⚠️ AI error: ...' string in the body instead of a 5xx/502. Frontend cannot distinguish success from failure; message text is rendered as if it were a valid answer.
Empty messages array is accepted (200) and sends an empty transcript to the LLM; no min_length validation.
llm() accepts max_tokens but never forwards it to LlmChat, so the per-route token limits (1200/1600/4000) are dead code.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called without .catch(); when the browser denies clipboard permission it throws an unhandled rejection ('NotAllowedError: Write permission denied'), which raises the CRA runtime-error overlay that covers the whole page and blocks all further clicks (tab switching became impossible). Also the button still flips to 'Copied' even though nothing was copied. Needs try/catch + textarea execCommand fallback + failure feedback.
build()/applyRefine() catch blocks are empty no-ops, so an LLM/network failure leaves the user with no error message and no preview - silent failure.

setLoading(true) is only cleared by img onLoad; if Pollinations returns an error/404 the 'Painting…' spinner stays forever (no onError handler). Also W/H selects and the Open/Download anchor have no data-testid.

issues: Rewrite preset buttons (Make Professional / Summarize / Change Tone) render as bare text with no border or background when inactive, so they don't look clickable.
Recipient/Tone stay in a hard-coded 1fr 1fr grid; recipient input collapses to ~169px and the placeholder is truncated ('Recipient (e.g. Hir'). Should stack to one column below ~640px.
React console warning on the Email tone <select> ('cannot be a child of <option>, will cause a hydration error') - render option labels as plain children/value pairs.

action_items: Wrap the Copy button clipboard call in try/catch with a fallback (this currently crashes the app with a runtime-error overlay that blocks the whole UI)
Return proper 5xx (or an {error:true} flag) from backend when the LLM/search fails instead of a 200 with an '⚠️ AI error' string, and surface it as an error state in the UI
Add error handling/messages to App Builder (empty catch blocks) and an onError handler for the generated image
Pass max_tokens through to LlmChat in llm(); validate non-empty chat messages
Stack Email recipient/tone into one column on mobile; give the preset buttons a visible button style
critical_code_review_comments: server.py llm(): exceptions are converted into normal 200 response bodies - callers cannot detect failure; raise HTTPException(502) instead.
server.py llm(): max_tokens parameter is unused (not passed to LlmChat/with_params).
App.js: iframe uses srcDoc with LLM-generated HTML without a sandbox attribute - same-origin script execution; add sandbox="allow-scripts".
App.js: multiple empty/silent catch blocks (BuildTab) violate the loading/success/error state rule.
Legacy /app/app.py (Streamlit) still exists in the repo and should be removed to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: None - app is stateless (no DB usage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (12 tests, all passing, ~22s with xdist). Public URL https://jarvis-os-52.preview.emergentagent.com. When testing the Email Copy button, note that a denied clipboard permission triggers a CRA error overlay iframe (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) that intercepts pointer events for the rest of the session - test Copy last, or grant clipboard-write permission via browser context. All 5 tabs were verified end to end (chat, email, research, image, build+refine).
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'placeholder page' bug is resolved: the React app at / now renders the Jarvis Command Center and every /api route responds correctly. Remaining Copy-button defect root cause: CopyBtn calls navigator.clipboard.writeText() with no rejection handler; in browsers/contexts where clipboard-write permission is not granted the returned promise rejects, producing an unhandled rejection that React dev overlay renders full-screen, blocking all subsequent user interaction.
